description: Octen gives ChatGPT live information from the web through Octen's hosted MCP server: real-time web search with query-relevant highlights and filters, a dedicated news vertical, broad multi-angle search for research and comparisons, clean URL-to-markdown extraction for reading and grounding answers, and (invite-only beta) image and video search. Users connect their Octen account via OAuth; no API key configuration is needed.
